senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of טמם)to obstruct, close, fill up. Part. pass. אָטוּם, f. אֲטוּמָה

units: <cite ref="Zevachim 61b:10">Zeb. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ באדמה</he> filled up with earth, opp. <cite ref="H00997"><he>חָלוּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 2:4:2">Y. B. Bath. II, 13ᶜ</cite> top <he>כותל א׳</he> a solid wall.
<cite ref="Niddah 24a:30">Nidd. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>גוף א׳</he> the stump of a human body (of the embryo).
Ib. אתּ שגולגלתו א׳ an embryo whose scull is a shapeless lump (no scull discernible). Y. ib. III, 50ᵈ top.—Trnsf.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 44b">Snh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>אוֹטֵם עונות</he> he locks up the sins (makes them invisible, cmp. <cite ref="I00556"><he>טָמַן</he></cite>); v. <cite ref="A01222"><he>אִיטְמוֹן</he></cite>.
